dialogue_texts: Oof, my head. My hands have regained control. Was I fighting uncontrollably?
Explain to me, was my mind clouded in a crimson fog?
You were suffering from a localized collapse of your mental boundaries known as "glohm".
"Glohm"? I've never heard of such a thing.
I thought I had finally found a way to stop the world from being so loud.
A lady in gothic clothing promised me a permanent holiday from feeling.
Who was this unauthorized travel agent?
She's in the inner sanctum now, "filing away" the rest of this world's messy emotions.
She said my isolation was the first step toward a perfect Order.
The Order is maintained through the balance of chaos.
I think it's time I revoked her operating license.
Please, My Majesty... don't let her turn the whole continent into a silent room.
Even if it's noisy, I'd think I'd rather be able to hear my own heart.
Don't worry. I will go in and fix the plumbing.
